bio: Leslie Gao is currently studying health sciences at Queen's University. You can spot him running events as a Health Sci First Year Rep, tutoring students aged 9–16 years in Ontario, authoring the newest research papers about Alzheimer's disease, or on a tree. In his natural element. Not only did he publish his own paper in his freshman year, but he also really has an eye, or hand, for art. For instance, he creates art with adults with mixed cognitive abilities and made his own shirt for the Eras Tour! If you really get to know him, he's great at singing “Santa Claus Is Coming to Town” and making it sound like “Always” by Daniel Caesar. Peak music taste.
name: Leslie Gao
program: Honours Bachelor of Health Sciences (BHSc) · Queen's University
